assumptions: Purchase quantities are optimized for the final ordered stops.
Stop selection is a corridor-based heuristic, not a globally optimal station set.
Retail prices are treated as USD per US gallon.
Vehicle tank capacity is 50 US gallons at 10 miles per gallon.

boundary.source: US Census TIGERweb Generalized_ACS2024 State_County MapServer layer 7, 1:500,000 contiguous states and DC
